messages:
Nadia: customer reported duplicate charges when a stream falls back during an in-progress toolcall. repro attached.
Ethan: sequence? toolcalls usually dedupe on request_id for non-streaming. streaming is messy.
Nadia: short sequence:
```
client -> stream(session=sess42)
router -> model-A handles stream
model-A emits in-progress toolcall (no stable final id yet)
router falls back -> connects to model-B
model-B emits final toolcall -> billing records final
model-A later flushes final on shutdown -> billing records final again
```
Ravi: we don't have a stable session id propagated across handoffs today, so billing can't detect dupes.
Ethan: mitigations: 1) router injects a stable `stream_session_id` at stream start and passes it to all handlers. 2) billing dedupes final toolcalls on (customer, stream_session_id, toolcall_hash).
Nadia: short-term workaround: billing-proxy can provisionalize any final toolcall that arrives within 1s of another final with same toolcall_hash and same customer, then reconcile asynchronously. avoids immediate double charge.
billing-bot: Created alert BILL-2001: deduped_toolcall_fallbacks > 0.05% on us-east for 30m.
Ravi: effort estimate: router header plumbing ~1d, handler libs update ~1d, billing-proxy dedupe + tests ~2d, console metric + alert ~0.5d. total ~4.5d.
Ethan: also add trace annotations for `fallback=true` so ops can find impacted streams.
Nadia: will draft RFC describing session id semantics and billing dedupe. also add an e2e test where handler A is killed mid-final and handler B finalizes, assert single confirmed charge.
deploybot: staging deploy started for billing-proxy@pr-88
Ethan: canary plan: 5% traffic with provisional mode on; watch BILL-2001 and invoice deltas for 1h before expanding.
Nadia: thanks — i'll own the RFC and the test harness. :thumbsup:
Ethan: :rocket:
